"Maybe Evolution" is an accurate label here, because, while the plants and animals in the Chernobyl exclusion zone are evolving along with the natural environment, which means "natural selection" is at work. However, that same environment has an entirely new factor to it, radioactive fallout from a meltdown. As the video portrays, the animals in the exclusion zone have managed to thrive, but this is ultimately due to the lack of human activity in the exclusion zone (until the Russians began their invasion of Crimea).
